conviction_note: No consensus, no options and no usable reaction history. The evidence leans slightly negative: Q3 laps a tougher base (Q3 2025 company SSS +3.3% with a double-digit September bagel-festival month, against -3.6% in Q2 2025), and Luckin's comps fell from -5.3% to -11.1% from Q2 to Q3 as delivery subsidies were lapped. Against that, the stock is at its 52-week low after falling about 40% since the Q2 print, Luckin reported month-by-month improvement into Q4, and RBI is still funding the company and has put its APAC GM on the board. p_up 48 on an abs move of 10 gives -0.4. The findings' own sum, -0.25, is close to this.
bar: Unsourced. No Q3 2026 revenue or EPS consensus could be found: Digrin shows the Q3 estimate blank, and Yahoo has one analyst with an FY2026 EPS estimate of -4.72 and no revenue estimate (https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/THCH/analysis/). The company gives no numeric guidance (Q2 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001877333/000121390026090969/ea030235701ex99-1.htm). The implicit bar is the Q2 2026 run-rate: revenue RMB273.4m (-21.7% YoY), system SSS -17.8%, company SSS -17.3%, adjusted corporate EBITDA -RMB21.0m. The Q3 2025 base is revenue RMB358.0m (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/12/09/3202149/0/en/Tims-China-Announces-Third-Quarter-2025-Financial-Results.html). print_vs_bar_pct of -3 means revenue near RMB265m against the Q2 run-rate. Every finding is capped small because the bar is unsourced.
positioning_check: Short interest (equibles, FINRA settlement 2026-10-30): 31,964 shares, up from 16,855 on 10-15. That is about 0.1% of 32.04m shares outstanding, with days to cover of 1.91 on 16,736 average daily volume (https://equibles.com/stocks/thch/short-interest). Not crowded, so the squeeze risk is small. No option chain exists (baseline options status empty_chain), so there is no skew. Tape: spot $1.00, -14.2% over 5 days, -2.0% over 20 days, -62.7% from the 52-week high and +0.4% above the 52-week low. Realised vol is 92% annualised. Average volume is about 14k shares a day, roughly $14k, so this is an extremely thin tape. The stock was $1.68 in pre-market on the Q2 print day, 2026-08-18 (grafa: https://grafa.com/en/news/united-states/tims-china-q2-2026-revenue-store-sales-thch).

findings.finding: Q3 2026 same-store sales are likely to print worse than Q2's -17.8% system and -17.3% company figures because the base gets tougher. Q3 2025 company SSS was +3.3% (system +1.3%), helped by a September 2025 bagel festival that produced double-digit SSS that month. Q2 2025 company SSS was -3.6%. Keeping Q2's two-year stack of about -21 points would put Q3 2026 company SSS near -24%. Delivery revenue, 65.7% of company-store revenue in Q2, also laps a Q3 2025 subsidy boost (+23.1% delivery revenue then).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None usable. The baseline history is empty (www.sec.gov 403), and the only data point found is $1.68 unchanged pre-market after Q2's -17.8% SSS print (grafa). The stock has since fallen to $1.00.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no consensus, so nobody publishes a Q3 SSS number. Had the tougher base been modelled into a bar, an estimate page would show a Q3 revenue estimate below RMB270m, and none exists. Part of it is surely in the price, because the stock is down about 40% since August.
findings.independence: This shares nothing with the Luckin finding, but it is an inference from the base plus the Q2 two-year stack, not a company number. Q2 2025 base: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1877333/000121390025080740/ea025462001ex99-1_thintern.htm. The Q2 2026 call blamed aggregators scaling back subsidies (https://www.webull.com/news/15426727522419712).

findings.finding: The direct peer Luckin (Q3 2026, reported 2026-11-03) showed both sides of the subsidy unwind. Self-operated SSS fell to -11.1% in Q3 from -5.3% in Q2, which points to Tims' Q3 comps deteriorating too. But management said SSS improved month by month from July to September and was accelerating into Q4, which supports constructive October and November exit-rate commentary from Tims on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Unknown. Tims has never quantified intra-quarter trends on recent calls; the Q2 call gave no July or August data.
findings.why_not_priced: Tims last spoke on 2026-08-18, before Luckin's Q3 print. A $14k-a-day tape with no analyst previews is unlikely to have translated a peer's monthly trajectory into this name. If it had, the stock would not have fallen 14% in the five sessions before the print.
findings.independence: This is a proxy: a peer, not the company. The monthly-improvement statement is from the Luckin call (https://quartr.com/events/luckin-coffee-inc-lknc-q3-2026_FPuPKDZO). The negative half of the same data is folded into the Q3 SSS finding above, so it is not counted twice.

findings.finding: The brand owner is still funding the company and deepening its involvement. THRI (RBI) agreed in June to buy up to US$55m of additional senior secured convertible notes in four tranches through early 2027, each subject to business-performance milestone conditions; the first US$15.8m closed in July 2026. On 2026-10-19 RBI swapped its international president on the board for Stanford Ming Lin, Tim Hortons APAC GM since June 2026 and a former Cotti board member, to 'coordinate between brand owner and the China business'. The money buys marketing, product innovation and openings split evenly between company and franchise stores, as the CFO said and as the September marketing ramp confirms. Liquidity is tight (cash RMB121m, current liabilities RMB1,059m against current assets RMB295m), so whether a second tranche closed is the funding question the release answers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None found for financing news on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The board change was reported only in Chinese trade press, from a 6-K. The tranche milestones are in the June agreement and nobody covers them. If the market read RBI's continued backing as reducing default risk, the stock would not be sitting at its 52-week low.
findings.independence: Separate documents: the June 9 release on the notes (https://thinternationallimited.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/tims-china-announces-appointment-mr-kwok-wah-cheung-chief) and the Q2 release (balance sheet, July tranche closing). Sign risk: if the release says a tranche milestone was missed, this turns negative.

findings.finding: Q3 adjusted corporate EBITDA is likely to show a wider loss than Q2's -RMB21.0m (-7.6% margin, against +RMB2.2m a year earlier). On the Q2 call the CFO said marketing spend would rise 'significantly' from September around the coffee and bagel festival, with marketing and product hiring from Q3. Company-store contribution margin was already down to 5.7% from 9.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: management told the market to expect the spend. The only unpriced part is its size, since no figure was given.
findings.independence: This shares the Q2 call with the financing finding's use-of-proceeds point. The margin trend is from the Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001877333/000121390026090969/ea030235701ex99-1.htm).

findings.finding: The stock goes into the print at $1.00, 0.4% above its 52-week low. It is down about 40% from the $1.68 pre-market price on the Q2 print day and down 14% in the last five sessions, with no company news since the Q3 date notice of 2026-11-16. Short interest roughly doubled to 31,964 shares (10-30), still only about 0.1% of shares outstanding and 1.9 days to cover. A sharply deteriorating Q3 is at least partly in the price.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the price itself. It is filed as context and sized at 0 because an unexplained drawdown in a microcap is not evidence about the print.
findings.independence: The tape is from the sealed baseline; the earlier price is from grafa (https://grafa.com/en/news/united-states/tims-china-q2-2026-revenue-store-sales-thch).

outside_window.finding: At $1.00 the stock is at the Nasdaq $1.00 minimum bid threshold. If it stays below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, a deficiency notice follows, and the company did a reverse split in January 2025 for the same reason. Any notice or split comes weeks after this window.

The second to fourth tranches of the US$55m THRI notes run to early 2027 and are subject to business-performance milestones. Closings after the window could make the release's disclosure moot or reverse it.

baseline_tension: The lean is negative but small and runs with the run-up: the stock has already fallen 14% in five days and about 40% since August to its 52-week low, so the tough-comp negative is probably largely priced.
